page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the running head at the top centre and the page number at the top right. Signature and catchword at the foot of the column. No marginal notes. Show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page on the left and bottom right are left out.

main_text.p: ficentia[?] ac liberalitate majori emolumento quàm detrimento ei fuerit.

Quod sanè argumento fuit, non solum prudentia ac solertia, sed etiam potentum gratia Rhodios tum plurimum valuisse. Incidit casus hic in annum urbis Romæ dxxxi, C. Flaminio Nepote, L. Furio Philo cos[?]. quinquennio ferè ante initium Pelli Punici secundi ab Annibale gesti, Olympiadis cxxxix anno altero.

Inter Σωτῆρα[?] in Rhodios tum liberales recensét Polybius Ptolemæum Ægypti regem cognomento Εὐεργέτην[?], Seleucum Ceraunum in Syria, Antigonum Δώσωνα[?] in Macedonia, Hieronem cum Gelone filio Syracusis, Prusiam in Bithynia, Mithridatem in Ponto regnantes, præter principes alios, & civitates plurimas, ac fœminam nobilem Chrysei-da, omnes quasi inter se hac in re liberalitate certantes. Rarum benevolentiæ exemplum, & nostro sæculo incredibile.

Vix dum quadriennium exierat post motum illum terræ, cum Rhodii partim incommodo suo, partim aliorum Græcorum, qui commerciis Ponticis utebantur, permoti, junctâ cum Prusiâ Bithyno belli societate, Byzantinos ab exigendo vectigali, quod ut necessitatibus suis subvenirent, præter morem poscebant omnes

page.notes: Left and right margins show only show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page; none were transcribed. Greek words marked [?] are uncertain: the Greek before "in Rhodios" and the accusatives after Ptolemaeum and Antigonum are hard to read on the scan. "ficentia" at the line start is probably "licentia", but the first letter is unclear. "cos[?]." is a probable abbreviation for "cos." The page number is read as 185 from the header.
